text: After a stockbroker kills his wife and colleagues, [his two little daughters vanish into a forest cabin|who_suffers|young children], where for five years something they call "Mama" keeps them alive. Found feral, Victoria and Lily move into a suburban house with their uncle Lucas and his girlfriend Annabel, and Mama follows them home. As Annabel grows close to the girls, their doctor uncovers the story of Edith Brennan, an asylum patient [who leapt from a cliff with her baby|origin|the wronged dead return], and [still searches for a child to hold|wants|a child to take or have].
